title: guajava cinerea
intro: Guajava cinerea, commonly known as Guava, is a tropical plant native to the Americas, belonging to the family Myrtaceae. This plant is rich in nutrients and antioxidants, providing various health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels, aiding in weight management, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Guajava cinerea include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Guajava cinerea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant activity.
